entity.description: The entity the hit shape belongs to, which is the body the shape hangs off rather than the collider entity when the collider is on a child

shapeId.description: The shape this side hit. 0xFFFFFFFF when the hit shape is no longer in the shape pool

distance.description: Distance from the query origin to the hit

normal.description: World space surface normal at the hit

faceIndex.description: Touched triangle for a mesh, convex or height field. 0xFFFFFFFF for other shapes

group.description: The group this query is from. A shape with the default group 0 is accepted by every query, so 0 here means accept everything

mask.description: The set of groups this query accepts, matched against word0 of the shape's filter data

excludeActorId.description: The actor to skip. A ground check needs this because the ray starts inside the shape the caller owns

pending.description: What the physics manager has queued for this entity, a mix of PhysicsFeature::PhysicsPending. Anything but a zero means the entity is in the managers rebuild queue.

body.description: Entity whose physx actor owns the shapes of this entity, which is the entity itself for a body. Cached so a collider which was moved to another parent can detach its shape from the old actor without walking the hierarchy.

characterId.description: The id of the controller this context holds for the entity.

radius.description: Radius of the capsule. Only read when the shape is a capsule.

height.description: Height of the capsule cylinder. The total height is height + 2 * radius. Only read when the shape is a capsule.

extents.description: Half extents of the box. Only read when the shape is a box.

slopeLimit.description: The cosine of the steepest slope the character can walk up. 0 disables the limit.

slideOnSlopes.description: Whether the character slides down a slope it cannot climb, instead of just stopping.

stepOffset.description: The height of the tallest obstacle the character can climb.

contactOffset.description: Skin around the character within which contacts are generated. Used to avoid numerical precision issues.

constrainClimbing.description: A capsule climbs according to the impact normal when this is false, and according to the step offset when it is true.

material.description: Name of the physics material. Falls back to the fallback material if it is not in the material table.

collisionGroup.description: Simulation filter data word0, read by the simulation filter shader.

collisionMask.description: The set of groups the character accepts when it moves

travelled.description: The distance the controller actually moved on the last physics frame, which is shorter than what was asked for when something was in the way.

isGrounded.description: If the character is touching the floor or not.

actorType.description: The physx actor type of the body.

mass.description: Mass in kilograms. 0 means the mass is derived from the shape volumes and the material densities.

useGravity.description: If the body is affected by gravity.

ccd.description: Continuous collision detection for the body.

collisionGroup.description: Simulation filter data word0, read by the simulation filter shader.

collisionFeedback.description: Simulation filter data word1, controls which contact callbacks are sent.

axisLock.description: The world space axes the body is locked along or around. Bit 0 locks movement along X, 1 along Y and 2 along Z, and bits 3, 4 and 5 lock rotation around those axes. Only a dynamic body has lock flags, so a static body reads none of them.

localPosition.description: Position of the shape relative to the body entity, added on top of the entity local transform.

localOrientation.description: Orientation of the shape relative to the body entity, added on top of the entity local transform.
